nina_sales: Acme-run POC: air-gapped colo, wants weekly minibundles, customer HSM signing, no vendor key escrow. Quick thumbs?
omar_se: Feasible. We can deliver unsigned minibundles + a signing-helper container for them to run inside HSM. Need HSM vendor + pkcs11 support confirmed.
lucy_infra: Packaging note: use delta chunking, avoid shipping full weights. Weekly diffs likely ~30-60GB depending on driver pinning. Need preflight: disk, container runtime, driver matrix.
henry_sec: Sec redlines: Redwood must never receive private keys. Audit logs must stay in-customer. Include SOW clause: BYOK, "Redwood will not accept or store private keys."
carol_cust: Confirmed Acme uses Luna HSM and will run tooling in a restricted jumpbox. They want rollback guidance and per-minibundle pricing.
ops-bot: ticket PKG-2150 created: signing-helper + pkcs11 example + preflight checklist.
omar_se: Pricing draft: one-time packaging $15k, per-minibundle handling $500. I'll refine after kernel/driver matrix tests.
nina_sales: Action items: @omar_se build signing-helper + pkcs11 example, @lucy_infra preflight one-pager, @henry_sec draft SOW clause, @carol_cust confirm jumpbox access and HSM middleware. Meeting Tue 11am PT. :thumbsup:
